hooks.command:
sh -c 'fallback='"'"'{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "deny", "permissionDecisionReason": "Magnolia required role policy denied this operation."}}'"'"'
block() { printf '"'"'%s\n'"'"' "$fallback"; }
exec 3<&0 || { block; exit $?; }
out=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/magnolia-hook.XXXXXX") || { block; exit $?; }
cleanup() { rm -f "$out"; }
trap cleanup 0
/TMPDIR/claude-scratchpad -m compchem_memory.hook claude pre-tool <&3 3<&- >"$out" &
hook_pid=$!
exec 3<&-
(
  elapsed=0
  while kill -0 "$hook_pid" 2>/dev/null; do
    if [ "$elapsed" -ge 12 ]; then
      kill -TERM "$hook_pid" 2>/dev/null
      sleep 1
      kill -KILL "$hook_pid" 2>/dev/null
      exit 0
    fi
    sleep 1
    elapsed=$((elapsed + 1))
  done
) </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &
timer_pid=$!
wait "$hook_pid"
status=$?
kill "$timer_pid" 2>/dev/null
wait "$timer_pid" 2>/dev/null
if [ "$status" -eq 0 ]; then cat "$out" || block; else block; fi
exit $?'
